Faith is at the heart of Florida’s communities.

I was grateful to sit down with faith leaders in Tampa yesterday to listen, learn, and discuss how we can work together to strengthen families and communities across our state, make Florida more affordable, and unite Floridians with one common goal: Defending the Florida Dream.

Faith, family, and community are foundational to the Florida Dream — and as Governor, I’ll fight to protect all three.

posts.text:
Proud to have the endorsement of Okaloosa County Sheriff Eric Aden.

Sheriff Aden has served the people of Okaloosa County across a law enforcement career that
began in 1995 — from patrol deputy, to school resource officer, to Sheriff of the county he grew up in.

I will always back the blue. As Governor, I'll make sure our law enforcement officers have the
resources, the pay, and the support that they deserve.
